key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 55% standard cost recovery cap; 65% for deepwater/high-cost blocks per Senegal Petroleum Code 2019. GTA (Greater Tortue Ahmeyim): ~65% given offshore deepwater context.
30% Corporate Income Tax (Impot sur les Societes) under Senegal Petroleum Code 2019 Art.65. GTA cross-border: Senegal CIT 30% on Senegal-side revenues. Mauritania side: 25% CIT.
PETROSEN holds 10% carried interest through exploration; option to acquire up to 40% paying interest post-discovery. GTA: PETROSEN 10% + Mauritanian SMH ~11%. Combined state equity GTA: ~21%.
